message.content: Based on the information provided, Thane Chambers suggests doing a group purchase of the new games. This suggestion comes from a conversation where he invites Li Hua to a shopping trip for PS5 games, stating, "Hey Li Hua! Are you up for some shopping together this weekend? Just saw that the local game store has some killer discounts on PS5 games! Let me know!" This indicates that Thane is proposing a group effort to buy new games, likely with the intention of sharing the savings or perhaps coordinating which games to get.
